scope_note: Companies in materials, pharmaceuticals, finance/banking, cybersecurity and adjacent verticals exploiting data with AI or quantum tools. Automated collection produces candidates; this pilot edition is a DRAFT BASELINE for the website's curation process; entries carry review_status. A result is not 'advantage' because AI or quantum appears in the announcement: every entry is placed on the evidence ladder below.

ladder_definitions.activity: A partnership, hiring move, patent, or platform purchase. Most announcements stop here.
ladder_definitions.capability: A benchmark, pilot, or demonstrated technical result.
ladder_definitions.operating-benefit: A measured improvement to a decision, workflow, throughput, accuracy, or cost inside a real organization.
ladder_definitions.competitive-advantage: An operating benefit relative to credible alternatives, with a reason competitors cannot readily reproduce it.

signals.workflow: End-to-end generative-AI drug discovery (Pharma.AI): target identification from omics/publication/patent data, then generative chemistry for molecule design.

data_advantage.mechanism: Integrated omics repositories, publication texts, patents and grants feed target selection; the same platform then designs the molecule, keeping discovery insight in one pipeline.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Platform-owned integration of public and licensed biomedical data with internal experimental feedback.

observed_outcome.claim: Rentosertib (ISM001-055), a TNIK inhibitor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis designed with the platform, met its Phase 2a endpoints and has now entered Phase III (GENESIS-IPF-3): 320 participants, 47 centers in China, 52 weeks, primary endpoint annual rate of FVC decline. First patient dosed September 10, 2026.
observed_outcome.period: Phase 2a results reported November 2024; Phase III initiated July 2026, first patient dosed September 2026.

evidence.verification: Trial identifiers published (NCT07687459, CTR20262475) make the trial registry-verifiable; efficacy remains investigational and the drug is not approved by any regulator.
evidence.limitations: Company press releases; Phase 2a data reported at a conference, full publication status not verified in this review; Phase III outcome unknown.

signals.next_milestone: Phase III interim or topline results (primary endpoint: annual rate of FVC decline over 52 weeks).
signals.would_strengthen: Positive Phase III readout; regulatory approval; independent replication of the platform's discovery economics (time/cost per candidate) versus industry benchmarks.
signals.would_weaken: Phase III miss on the primary endpoint; disclosure that conventional discovery could have produced the candidate comparably fast and cheap.

signals.workflow: Azure Quantum Elements: AI screening of 32 million candidate solid electrolytes down to 23, physics-based filtering, then synthesis and prototype battery at PNNL.

data_advantage.mechanism: Graph-neural-network models trained on known materials, combined with physics-based simulation at cloud scale.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Access to cloud supercomputing tailored for chemistry; PNNL synthesis and testing capability closes the loop from prediction to hardware.

observed_outcome.claim: AI screening reduced 32 million candidates to 23 plausible ones; PNNL synthesized one and built a working prototype solid-electrolyte battery.
observed_outcome.comparator: Screening throughput versus conventional materials-discovery workflows.

evidence.verification: Widely covered by independent science press; the prototype was physically built and tested by PNNL.
evidence.limitations: A prototype, not a product; no published commercial deployment or quantified advantage over existing electrolytes at scale. First-edition entry: no dedicated follow-up search has yet confirmed or ruled out later developments; treat staleness as unverified until the second edition.

signals.next_milestone: Any disclosed commercial use of AI-screened materials in a shipping product, or a follow-up publication quantifying performance.
signals.would_strengthen: Product integration with measured performance/cost data; a second group replicating the discovery-to-hardware cycle on a different material class.
signals.would_weaken: No follow-up after multiple years; prototype performance below conventional alternatives in independent tests.

signals.workflow: Decision Intelligence Pro: generative-AI transaction risk scoring on the Mastercard network, assessing relationships between entities around each transaction in under 50 milliseconds.

data_advantage.mechanism: Network-scale view: 143 billion transactions scored per year; the gen-AI layer scans one trillion data points spanning account, purchase, merchant and device information.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Proprietary cross-bank transaction network data that no single issuer can see.

observed_outcome.claim: Initial modeling: fraud-detection rates improved on average 20%, up to 300% in some instances; false positives reduced by more than 85% in the company's own analysis.
observed_outcome.period: Announced February 2024; rollout from later that year.

evidence.verification: Press-release claims attributed to 'initial modelling' and 'our own analysis'; no independent verification found in this review.
evidence.limitations: Self-reported; methodology not published; 'up to 300%' is a best case, not an average. First-edition entry: no dedicated follow-up search has yet confirmed or ruled out later developments; treat staleness as unverified until the second edition.

signals.next_milestone: An independent issuer or regulator quantifying realized fraud-loss and false-positive changes in production.
signals.would_strengthen: Named bank reporting measured production results; peer-reviewed or regulator-published efficacy data.
signals.would_weaken: Banks quietly rolling back DI Pro; regulator findings on false-positive harm to customers.

signals.workflow: Three-track roadmap (2026-2028): quantum-inspired algorithms on classical IT for immediate gains; operational tests on Pasqal neutral-atom machines under production conditions; hybrid classical-quantum deployment. First focus: monitoring capital-reserve consumption linked to risk-weighted assets.

data_advantage.mechanism: In-house quantum ecosystem: trained business teams, strategic coordinators and production project managers, plus access to Pasqal simulators and machines.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Seven-year collaboration (since 2019) on counterparty credit-default risk and portfolio optimization; a bank building production muscle rather than running isolated pilots.

observed_outcome.claim: Announced intent to move from research to operational deployment; initial production use cases targeted as early as 2028. No production efficacy numbers yet.

evidence.verification: Joint announcement; roadmap and 2028 target are intentions, not results.
evidence.limitations: No measured outcome yet; production target is aspirational at announcement.

signals.next_milestone: First disclosed quantum-inspired algorithm running in a production capital-markets process (the 2028 target).
signals.would_strengthen: Any production deployment with measured performance versus the classical baseline; third-party confirmation it is not rebranded classical code.
signals.would_weaken: Missed 2028 target; quiet discontinuation; independent analysis showing equivalent classical methods match the 'quantum-inspired' results.

signals.workflow: Charlotte AI agentic security analyst: automated detection triage (verdict, confidence, recommendation, explanation), multi-agent investigations across endpoint, identity, cloud and network with a shared environment memory.

data_advantage.mechanism: Native integration with Falcon platform telemetry; agentic triage trained and tested against the Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR expert team.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: One of the largest proprietary endpoint/identity/cloud telemetry corpora in the industry, plus expert-team feedback as a training signal.

observed_outcome.claim: >98% decision accuracy with agentic detection triage; 70% reduced manual effort during investigations; 90% reduced incident response time.
observed_outcome.comparator: Accuracy claim compared to Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR expert team decisions; effort/time claims relative to prior analyst workflows.
observed_outcome.period: Claims current on the vendor page as of the 2026-10-25 check; original publication date not established.

evidence.verification: Figures from CrowdStrike marketing with methodology footnotes; no independent verification found in this review.
evidence.limitations: Datasheet footnotes define time savings as analyst time that 'would have been spent' triaging average detection volumes; conditions of measurement not independently audited.

signals.next_milestone: An independent study (or a customer with named metrics) on triage accuracy and response-time changes in production.
signals.would_strengthen: Peer-reviewed or customer-published triage accuracy data; SOC analyst throughput changes verified by a third party.
signals.would_weaken: Customers reporting agentic-triage error costs; insurers or regulators constraining automated closure of detections.

signals.workflow: Cash Flow Intelligence: AI cash forecasting, visibility and reconciliation across multiple banking relationships, integrated with the J.P. Morgan Access portal, replacing spreadsheet-based treasury workflows.

data_advantage.mechanism: Bank-side view of the customer's own payment flows across ERP systems and banking reports; the model sees consolidated flows no single internal system contains.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: J.P. Morgan's position as the cash-management bank with cross-bank consolidation.

observed_outcome.claim: Reduced manual treasury work by 50% and saved $100K annually (customer case study, attributed to Prysmian's VP & Treasurer).
observed_outcome.comparator: Prior spreadsheet-based forecasting and manual reconciliation.

evidence.verification: Customer-attributed quotes in a J.P. Morgan Payments case study; not independently verified.
evidence.limitations: Single-customer case study; $100K is small against Prysmian's scale, suggesting early-stage deployment rather than full migration. First-edition entry: no dedicated follow-up search has yet confirmed or ruled out later developments; treat staleness as unverified until the second edition.

signals.next_milestone: Broader rollout metrics (entities migrated, forecast-accuracy change) or a second corporate customer publishing comparable numbers.
signals.would_strengthen: Forecast-accuracy improvements quantified; multi-bank adoption beyond one treasury team.
signals.would_weaken: Reversion to spreadsheets; accuracy issues driving manual rework.

signals.workflow: CompactifAI: tensor-network compression of large language models (restructures weight matrices, targeted retraining 'healing'), deployed on cloud, on-premises and edge devices.

data_advantage.mechanism: Quantum-inspired tensor-network mathematics applied to model weights; claims 80-95% size reduction with immaterial accuracy loss; retained over 97% of baseline accuracy in Xeon 6 benchmarks.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Named deployments across millions of devices (drones, satellites, vehicles, telecoms); partners include Allianz, Bosch, Iberdrola, PwC, Telefónica; HP, Orange, Scania, Santander invested.

observed_outcome.claim: Llama 3.3 70B compressed ~50% on disk (about 130 GiB to about 65 GiB) running on Intel Xeon 6 P-cores; throughput +107.0% and latency -51.7% at 256 concurrent users; $570M Series C at $1.7B valuation (July 2026).
observed_outcome.comparator: Baseline uncompressed model on the same hardware; an independent Sopra Steria evaluation of Llama 3.1 8B supported the resource-reduction-with-accuracy-maintenance claim.
observed_outcome.period: Benchmarks July 23, 2026; Series C reported July 27, 2026.

evidence.verification: Benchmark methodology published in press release; Sopra Steria independent evaluation exists but with limited public detail; 'millions of devices' not independently confirmed.
evidence.limitations: Quantum-inspired classical math, not quantum hardware; best-case benchmark configuration; accuracy-retention claims vary by model.

signals.next_milestone: A named large customer publishing production inference-cost reductions attributable to CompactifAI.
signals.would_strengthen: Replication of compression results by a second independent evaluator; sustained enterprise renewals.
signals.would_weaken: Competing compression (quantization/distillation) matching results without tensor networks; accuracy degradation reports from production users.

signals.workflow: EUMEN quantum chemistry platform for molecular simulation in Alzheimer's drug discovery: candidate discovery and optimization using quantum algorithms.

data_advantage.mechanism: Quantum chemistry simulation applied to CNS drug candidates.
data_advantage.distinctive_access: Early-mover access to a quantum chemistry software stack partnered with a major pharma's discovery pipeline.

observed_outcome.claim: Partnership announced February 2021; no public efficacy outcome found since.

evidence.verification: No independent outcome; no recent public milestone located in this review.
evidence.limitations: Quantum chemistry simulation for drug discovery remains research-stage; five years without a disclosed milestone.

signals.next_milestone: Any disclosed candidate, publication, or continuation/renewal of the collaboration.
signals.would_strengthen: A quantum-derived candidate entering Roche's pipeline; peer-reviewed quantum-chemistry results on CNS targets.
signals.would_weaken: Silent discontinuation; classical simulation matching the same results.

draft_note: Pilot edition compiled 2026-10-25 by Perplexity Computer as a draft baseline. The website's curation process governs promotion and edits. Statuses are first-edition observations: 'stale' marks entries where a follow-up search found no public milestone since the source date; all other entries are 'new' to this ledger and have not yet had a second edition to compare against.
